summary.name: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio
summary.one_liner: Alibaba Cloud's model hosting catalog offering Qwen and third-party models for text, image, audio, video, speech, embeddings, and reranking.
use_cases: choosing a model for reasoning and coding tasks
generating images and videos from text or images
transcribing recorded audio or live speech
improving search retrieval with embeddings and reranking
extracting text or structured data from images and videos
summary.what_it_does: This page is a recommended-models index for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, grouped by modality. It lists text generation models in tiers (complex reasoning and coding, balanced, fast and cost-effective), visual understanding and image/video generation and editing models, a real-time interactive world model, and text-to-speech, speech recognition, and speech-to-speech models. It also covers an Omni model that handles text, image, audio and video, embedding and reranking models, and a Decision Model that performs classification, yes/no decisions and scoring in one pass with probabilities and confidence. The page links to a Model Plaza for the full list of Qwen, third-party, domain-specific and legacy models.
notable: Covers Qwen and third-party models across text, image, video, audio and speech
Omni model integrates understanding and generation across text, images, audio and video
Decision Model returns probability distributions and confidence for classification and scoring
caveats: Page lists models by name only; specific pricing and per-model limits are not shown on this page
Some entries are listed as preview (qwen3.6-max-preview)
Non-real-time audio output requires qwen3.5-omni-plus rather than the newer Omni model
